description: Records matching a text and filters, a page at a time. Pass next as cursor for the next page.

attackVector.description: Attack vectors from the CVSS vector, any of

component.description: A component of the vendor, as on the vendor's page; needs vendor

cursor.description: The next value of the previous page

cwe.description: CWE ids such as CWE-79, any of

published.description: Published within the last 7 days, 30 days or 12 months

q.description: Words to look for in the title, description, products and ids

signal.description: Signals, all of: kev (in CISA KEV), fix (a fix is listed), nofix (no fix listed), cve (has a CVE id)

sort.description: Order of the results; relevance needs q

vendor.description: A vendor key such as microsoft or schneider-electric

name: search_vulnerabilities
